The entry's stated proof - off-price SOLD while deep discount was BOUGHT - is gone entirely, not merely weakened. AND THE SHARPER VERSION, WHICH IS THIS HOUR'S NEW FACT: DG HAS CROSSED ABOVE DLTR. The 09:47 entry named DG 'the LAGGARD of the bid pair' and that is the sympathy-laggard setup the rulebook lists; the pair read +1.69% against +2.62% at the strike, +3.35% against +3.44% at 13:22, and now +3.62% against +3.49%. DG is the strongest of the ten. The named setup was consumed by its own thesis working. THE CONFIRMATION SURVIVES THAT ON ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN ON LOYALTY TO THE ENTRY: the only tape on which this specification ever executes is one where the framing is restored, because a fill at 128.40 needs a 2.24% give-back from here, putting DG at +1.30% against DLTR at +3.49% - a laggard again and by a wider margin than at the strike. The cohort was the entry's EVIDENCE; the RECLAIM is the setup, and the reclaim is intact and stronger than at any prior check. ALL THREE NAMED INVALIDATIONS CHECKED SEPARATELY AND NONE HAS FIRED. ONE, a trade below 126.24: NOT TRIGGERED across the full 13:30Z-18:15Z series of fifty-eight bars, the level set on the opening bar and never revisited; this run re-confirms the 13:22 correction that the lowest low after the opening bar is 127.10 on the 13:35Z bar. THREE, DLTR giving back its whole move and closing red while DG closes red: DLTR is 131.01 bid at +3.49%, essentially unmoved from +3.44% an hour ago. STRUCTURE IS AT ITS STRONGEST OF THE SESSION: a fresh session high of 131.640 on the 17:30Z bar, five consecutive higher lows into 18:15Z at 129.765, 130.480, 131.010, 131.205 and 131.355, and relative strength of +4.32% against SPY at -0.70%, the widest of the day. VALID AND VERY UNLIKELY TO BE REACHED IS THE HONEST READING, AND IT IS A DIFFERENT SENTENCE FROM EITHER 'STILL LIVE' OR 'DEAD'. Expires 15:30 ET today, 68 minutes out at the time of this read. THE WEAKNESS, STATED BEFORE THE OUTCOME: this is a RECLAIM, not the day-2 continuation the rulebook prefers, because a fully round-tripped gap has no move left to continue. Today the invalidation still has not fired - the 8/31 low was 131.15, five cents above it - and the entry is still refused. That is the correct shape: a spec can die on price and the thesis can die separately and later, and blurring them is how a board talks itself back into a trade.
